newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank Italy seen checking mark/lira rates.
newsitem.headline: Bank Italy seen checking mark/lira rates.

text.p: The Bank of Italy was checking mark/lira rates on the foreign exchanges at around 998 lire in early European trade, dealers said.
Mark/lira was quoted at 997.40/7.60 by 0838 GMT compared with morning low of 998.80.
The central bank also checked prices in trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The Bank of Italy is calling continuously but it hasn't dealt with us although it's highly probable that it's sold around 998," one broker said.
"The Bank of Italy is asking prices. At these levels, around 998 it is normal. They're not welcome levels," another said.
